arome.priority: arome_hd → arome → arpege → seamless (cloud: arpege → arome → seamless)

meta.slr_method: Roebber simplifié (base 14, calibré Alpes) - facteurs: temp, humidity, wind
meta.snow_quality: wet if temp > -2°C AND dew_point > -3°C, else dry
meta.freezing_level_correction: corrected=true when API value > elevation AND temp <= 0°C
